fragile.label: MEASURED_PROXY + DERIVED thresholds
fragile.definition_worst: position is worst-case-fragile at eps if ||δh||/||h|| < m/||d||/||h|| i.e. an aligned perturbation of relative size eps flips argmax
fragile.definition_iso: isotropic 2-sigma: rel eps flips when eps > m*sqrt(5120)/(||h||||d||)
fragile.eps_source: EPS is a hypothesized residual relative error. Descent hold_output_rel_l2 at Q4 is 0.04-0.11 on scored organs (CITED g1-heterogeneous-allocation). Layer-63 output/input norm 2.60396 is amplification (CITED contract), not an eps.

acceptance.label: MEASURED on Q4-lm_head probe; metric DEFINITION is proposed
acceptance.name: margin_preservation_statistic
acceptance.requires: teacher hidden (captured) and candidate lm_head, or first-order δh from a candidate body organ

definition.per_position: preserve iff argmax_c == argmax_t AND (m_t < tau OR m_c >= beta * m_t)
definition.knife_edge_hold: on positions with m_t < tau, require argmax match (already in per_position)

proposed_gate.note: Gates are POLICY, not measured thresholds. Last-token hold 1.0 is the doctor capability_gate. Cosine-alone is NEVER sufficient (CITED doctor).

acceptance.how_to_score_a_body_candidate_without_ge: Apply candidate organ to captured X (legal site only). Inject output error into residual as first-order δh (down/o: 5120-wide write error; gate/up: refuse unless post_swiglu captured). δz = δh @ W_lm.T (or <δh, d> for pair). Recompute argmax via top-k refresh if |δz| can admit a new competitor. Score MPS. This is first-order; REOPEN_IF a generate disagrees.

allocation.label: PROJECTED from MEASURED subspace rank + CITED codec formulas. Not a packed artifact.
allocation.principle: Protect the union of (w_top1-w_top2) at fragile positions in residual writes and lm_head rows. Cheap-quantize the orthogonal complement. Do not allocate by tensor RMS or |W| kurtosis unless that axis coincides with the decision span.

metal_path.body: Existing qwen_uniform_q4_group64_matvec_geo_tpr64_tg128 (or the 2/3-bit native sibling when packed). No expand-to-Q4-then-generic-GEMV.
metal_path.subspace_correction: After the cheap GEMV, FMA a rank-R correction: y += U @ (V @ x). R is tens, so this is a tiny GEMV. U,V stay bf16 (or q8) in threadgroup. Discard V@x after the FMA.
metal_path.lm_head_hybrid: Same Q3/Q4 GEMV over the body rows; add a dense bf16 gather-GEMV over the exact-row index list (n ~ hundreds). Argmax over the union. Do not materialize a full bf16 lm_head.
metal_path.reject: packed-then-expand-to-Q4-then-generic-GEMV unless a GPU lane measures expansion still wins (this lane did not run GPU).

classification.ESSENTIAL: decision subspace of residual writes (rank R95 of {w1-w2} on fragile positions); exact lm_head rows for specials + observed top-2; last-layer residual path at last-token / think / tool delims
classification.CONDITIONAL: tool-call / think-close / stop rows of lm_head (exact, cheap); runtime refine-if-small-margin is CONDITIONAL compute, not stored bits
classification.COMPENSATABLE: early-layer MLP (doctor L0 1-bit vacuous hold; this capture's early |cos| with d is low)
classification.PREDICTABLE: chat-template positions with huge margin (im_start, role words) — error cannot flip
classification.SHARED: one decision basis U across residual writes if per-layer U does not pay for itself
classification.REDUNDANT: residual channels high in |h| but near-zero in |d| (test: 3994 if ranks diverge)
classification.UNKNOWN: heads (no mixer_x); tool-formatted prompts (absent from capture); confirmed final-norm logits
